seoTitle: How to Fix an Inverted Camera on Instagram Video Calls
metaDescription: Fix a mirrored or upside-down front camera during Instagram video calls with in-app and phone-level camera settings, no third-party apps needed.
intro: A flipped or mirrored front camera during Instagram video calls can be confusing and uncomfortable to work around. This guide covers checking Instagram's in-app camera settings, adjusting phone orientation settings, and updating the app to fix the issue on Android and iPhone.

steps.heading: Understand why the camera flips
steps.body: This issue can be caused by app glitches, outdated Instagram versions, phone orientation bugs, or conflicts with your device's system camera settings.

steps.heading: Check Instagram's in-app camera settings
steps.body: Look through Instagram's call and camera settings for any mirroring or orientation option that may need adjusting.

steps.heading: Adjust your phone's camera and orientation settings
steps.body: Check your device's system-level camera and orientation settings, since these can conflict with how Instagram displays the camera feed.

steps.heading: Update the app and clear cache
steps.body: Update Instagram to the latest version and clear its cache on Android or iPhone to remove any glitches causing the flip.

steps.heading: Test the fix on a call
steps.body: Start a test video call to confirm the camera now displays correctly.

faq.question: Why does my Instagram video call camera appear flipped?
faq.answer: It's usually due to app glitches, an outdated Instagram version, phone orientation bugs, or a conflict with your device's system camera settings.

faq.question: Do I need a third-party app to fix a flipped camera?
faq.answer: No, this can typically be fixed using in-app settings, phone camera settings, and updating the app, without any extra software.

faq.question: Does this issue happen on both Android and iPhone?
faq.answer: Yes, it can occur on both platforms, though the exact settings to check may differ slightly between them.

faq.question: Will clearing my cache fix the flipped camera?
faq.answer: Clearing the cache can resolve glitches contributing to the issue, especially when combined with updating the app.
